title: Field Service Technician
description:
O Grupo Sécheron Hasler continua a tradição suíça de mais de 140 anos no domínio da tecnologia ferroviária. Somos um dos principais fornecedores mundiais de componentes e soluções de segurança eléctrica e eletrónica e de sistemas de energia de tração para a indústria ferroviária, fornecendo também soluções para energias renováveis, redes de corrente contínua e outros sistemas industriais. O nome Grupo Sécheron Hasler é sinónimo mundial de qualidade suíça e representa uma referência líder em produtos de última geração fornecidos ao mercado.

Com mais de 1.300 funcionários em todo o mundo, estamos onde quer que os nossos clientes estejam, fornecendo produtos aprovados nos países ou mercados dos nossos clientes e prestando serviços de cadeia de fornecimento e atendimento ao cliente localmente.

Para a nossa unidade em São Paulo, estamos atualmente à procura de um Field Service Technician para reforçar a nossa equipa no Brasil. O Field Service Technician irá trabalhar cerca de 40% do tempo em campo em São Paulo, e cerca de 30% do tempo fora de São Paulo, podendo ser no Brasil ou no estrangeiro.

Como Field Service Technician, estas serão as suas responsabilidades:

Atendimento ao cliente:

- Garantir o desempenho eficiente dos serviços prestados aos nossos clientes no Brasil (ou no estrangeiro, se solicitado);

- Fornecer as atividades de campo quando solicitado: supervisão de instalação, testes, comissionamento e treinamentos;

- Executar as intervenções de emergência no local;

- Efetuar reparações no local ou nas instalações da Sécheron;

- Executar os trabalhos de manutenção;

- Elaboração de relatórios técnicos.

Suporte a vendas e execução de contratos:

- Apoio ao Engenheiro de Vendas em levantamentos de subestações e permissões de acesso ao local;

- Realizar orçamentos de reparações;

- Estar atento para identificar novas oportunidades de negócios: venda de peças de reposição, reparos, serviços on-site, modernizações, retrofits, treinamentos, contratos de manutenção, etc.

Logística e stock:

- Apoio na gestão de stocks

- Receção de mercadorias: Inspecionar a mercadoria após o processo de importação e identificar se a mesma segue de acordo com o pedido do cliente, informar o número de série dos itens, embalar o material e solicitar emissão de nota fiscal e transporte.

Requisitos:

- Experiência em instalação, teste e comissionamento de equipamento elétrico. Idealmente com experiência em manutenção e experiência em subestações de tração de corrente contínua.

- Ativo, dinâmico, boa organização de tarefas e planeamento.

- Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autónoma e em equipa.

- Grau técnico ou bacharelato em: Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Industrial ou Engenharia Mecânica

- Disponibilidade para viajar no Brasil ou no exterior (70%).

- Fluência em Português e Inglês é necessária, qualquer outra língua adicional seria bom ter (Francês, Alemão, Espanhol)

O que oferecemos:

Temos hierarquias planas e incentivamos a comunicação direta entre departamentos e níveis de gestão. Isto permite-nos tomar decisões rapidamente.

Damos aos nossos funcionários total responsabilidade pelas suas tarefas de trabalho. Encorajamos todos os funcionários a tomarem iniciativas e a contribuírem para a excelência operacional da empresa e damos-lhes amplas oportunidades para atingirem os seus objectivos de crescimento pessoal e profissional.

Job Description
We are looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to join our team, focusing on AWS, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps best practices. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining highly scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure to support our trading operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in cloud computing, automation, and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring high availability and performance for mission-critical systems.

  • Cloud Infrastructure Management: Design, deploy, and maintain scalable and resilient infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC).
  • Kubernetes Administration: Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters for containerized applications, ensuring high availability and security.
  • Automation & CI/CD: Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for efficient deployment, testing, and monitoring of applications.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Develop comprehensive monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar tools to improve system reliability.
  • Security & Compliance: Apply best practices for cloud security, IAM policies, and compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, etc.).
  • Incident Response & Performance Optimization: Troubleshoot issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement fixes to optimize performance.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Utilize Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools to automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
  • Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Work closely with developers, security teams, and operations to promote DevOps culture and best practices.
  • Disaster Recovery & Reliability Engineering: Design failover and backup strategies to ensure business continuity in the event of failures.

Background And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, or DevOps roles.
  • Interest in or any exposure to trading or similar themes would be desirable (not essential)

Competences and personality

  • Strong expertise in AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, VPC, IAM, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS, K3s, or self-managed clusters).
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible).
  • Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts (VPC, Load Balancers, DNS, Firewalls).
  • Experience with DevOps methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps practices.
  • Experience with high-performance and low-latency (sub millisecond) systems.
  • Familiarity with serverless architectures and event-driven computing.
  • Exposure to cloud cost optimization and FinOps strategies.
  • Previous exposure working with Crypto, Traditional Finance (Trad Fi) or Trading would be highly desirable but not essential

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

Open Source Networking Software Engineer - ToR Switch / SmartNIC / DPU

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Open Source Networking Software Engineer - ToR Switch / SmartNIC / DPU role at Canonical

Software has moved to play a central role in network technology. From outstanding routing implementations like Bird and FRR to overlay networking technology such as OVN/OVS and Cilium, from kernel with SwitchDev to userspace with DPDK, from P4 to OpenFlow, the relationship between network innovation and software continues to deepen. We are building teams to bring the very best open source networking software to market in a well integrated and opinionated stack that brings the latest hyperscaler innovation to end users and enterprise customers.
We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data center networking, from bare metal through virtualization, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.
You will have a good chance of success if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking, with a special interest in the interface of hardware ASICs for acceleration and software for innovation and control. We value experience in open switch initiatives such as SoNIC and DENT, and upstream experience with components such as routing, kernel networking, eBPF, DNS, firewalls and load balancers. Our selection process is rigorous and requires work from the candidate as six to eight interviews over a period of months. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation, security and performance in your work.
At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, Private Clouds, MAAS and Kubernetes across a broad range of devices and use cases.
Location : we have network software engineering roles in APAC (Top-of-Rack switches) and Americas (SmartNIC/DPU) time zones.
What your day will look like

  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available
  • Participate upstream and deliver the Ubuntu SoNIC stack
  • Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers
  • Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the data center
  • Write high-quality, well-designed, fast, secure and well-documented software
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality fixes
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organization
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Work from home, with global travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Knowledge of networking: architecture, design, and protocols
  • Understanding of Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Fluency in C/C++ and at least one of Rust, Python or Golang
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Familiarity with existing open source networking technologies: SONIC / SAI, kernel (e.g. eBPF, AF_XDP), DPDK, Switchdev, OVN, Open vSwitch.
  • Familiarity with data path hardware acceleration protocols and interfaces, such as RDMA, RoCE, iWARP, NVMe, SR-IOV
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, and RISC-V
  • Experience in complex IP network engineering and implementation
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, e.g., QEMU, KVM, etc.
  • Previous contribution to open source projects and community involvement
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world every day. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. A Day in the Life

This is an opportunity for an experienced data scientist who is looking to grow professionally and make an impact on the lives of patients across Latin America.   • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, math, or engineering.

  • Broad understanding of project management.

Preferred qualifications include a master’s degree in Data Science or Health Economics, a strong publication record on large datasets, multilingual presentation skills, relevant certifications (e.g., CHDA, PMP), membership in professional organizations, and experience in a medical environment.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work performed but are not exhaustive of all responsibilities and skills required for this position.

Medtronic offers a competitive salary and flexible benefits package. We prioritize our employees' contributions, offering resources and compensation plans to support every career and life stage.

We lead global healthcare technology, tackling the most challenging health problems by searching for solutions. title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Sales Operations Analysts to join a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be a leader who shows initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions.
The role entails

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Review opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Manager to improve sales data quality and processes
  • Report on data quality metrics to executive level stakeholders
  • Implement surveys and define metrics for executive level stakeholders
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Lead automation and streamline the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience in a sales operations/sales order processing role
  • Experience in a technology subscription-based business
  • Experience driving data quality improvement
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to manage across boundaries and communicate effectively, particularly working with Sales, Legal, Finance and Marketing teams
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Instructional Designer (B2B / Management courses)

  • Product Management
  • Senior
  • Full-time

Description

TripleTen for Business empowers companies to achieve their business goals by bridging talent gaps in Data Science, AI for professionals, Python Development, and Management.

Our transformative approach includes tailored training programs, informed by comprehensive pre-training assessments, ensuring precise alignment with client needs. With expert-led content and personalized mentoring, we help employees excel and achieve new levels of proficiency.

We are expanding our reach beyond individual learners to offer assessment and upskilling solutions for companies worldwide. Our newly launched B2B team focuses on providing tailored Technical, AI, and management soft skills training to help organizations enhance the capabilities of their workforce.

We are looking for an Instructional Designer to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for developing courses on management, soft skills, and cognitive skills.

Please note that after applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call.

What you will do

Update our current courses on management

  • Work with client feedback and subject-matter expert recommendations to identify areas for course quality improvement;

    • Develop new courses

    • Participate in learning needs analysis and high-level course design with the Product Manager and SME;
    • Map learning outcomes for the whole course and for each module and lesson;
    • Write content based on SME’s materials, prepare practice exercises and learning aids;
    • Design online classes, workshops, and other synchronous online events in collaboration with expert mentors;
    • Prepare materials about new courses for sales manager training;
    • Create documentation about courses and keep it up to date.

    Requirements

    • Worked as an instructional designer / learning experience designer / learning content developer / program designer for at least 3 years;
    • Has proven experience working with soft skills, leadership or management training;
    • Knows models and methodologies for complex skills learning;
    • Can develop various forms of educational content (long reads, projects, practice tasks, infographics, assessment, etc.);
    • Can design and implement skills and knowledge assessment into the course;
    • Can structure educational experiences, build Learning Journey Maps (LJMs);
    • Can work with modern tools to create learning aids (we use Figma, HeyGen, Supademo).

    What we value:

    • Autonomy — you propose, do, ask questions independently;
    • Empathetic, learner-centric approach — you make decisions considering learners' interests, concerns, and context; you understand that the responsibility for successes and failures is shared equally between us and the learners;
    • Dedication and commitment — you are genuinely invested in achieving the best outcomes and are proud of what you do;
    • Attention to detail and thoroughness — you'll be processing a lot of advanced content.

    What we can offer you

    • Performance appraisals once a year and a bonus system.
    • Digital office. We use modern digital tools like Miro, Notion, Slack, etc., to keep our teamwork smooth.
    • Have the freedom to work professionally. We trust your experience and don't believe in micromanaging.
    • Room to grow. Our product is expanding rapidly, so it's a great chance to join and challenge yourself.
    • Diverse and close-knit team. We're spread out across the world: Europe, Asia, North and South America.

    We're excited to get to know you and work together!

    Disclosures

    • At this time we are unable to offer H1B sponsorship opportunities in the USA.

title: Engenharia de Dados para Governança de Dados
description:
Vem ser Ituber & vem fazer Itaú_

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 60 milhões de clientes em 18 países. Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um quadro com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças. Não queremos você apenas por achar que tem a nossa cara. Queremos ter um pouco da sua também!


O que você precisa para ser um Ituber?

Estamos buscando pessoas que queiram se desenvolver e aprender constantemente, compartilhando, colaborando, inovando e entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes. Aqui a gente não sabe tudo, a gente vai de turma_


Como é o dia a dia de um Ituber nessa área?

  • Desenvolvimento e a implantação de soluções de dados.
  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis, garantindo eficiência e segurança.
  • Atuar na reestruturação dos processos de dados da área, que atualmente estão em um ambiente não produtivo, propondo soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Colaborar com os times de engenharia de dados e analytics para garantir a governança e qualidade dos dados utilizados em análises e tomadas de decisão.
  • Construir e manter fluxos de bases e pipelines de dados voltados à geração de insights e estudos estratégicos.
  • Produzir e transformar dados com foco em gerar valor para a governança e para os stakeholders do negócio.
  • Conduzir estudos analíticos que apoiem decisões e promovam melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar a evolução dos processos e a adoção de boas práticas em governança de dados, segurança e compliance.

No que você precisa mandar bem?

  • Ferramentas open-source e da AWS voltadas para Big Data (e.g. Hive, Spark, Presto/Athena, Hudi, Kafka, Parquet, Avro, Glue Jobs, RedShift)
  • Modelagem Conceitual, Lógica e Física de Dados Estruturados e Não-Estruturados
  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre arquitetura de soluções AWS (e.g. IAM, EC2, Roles, S3, Security groups)
  • Conhecimentos específicos sobre os elementos de Analytics utilizados na arquitetura de soluções AWS para a construção e sustentação de pipeline de dados (ETL/ELT), incluindo EMR, Glue, Athena e RedShift.
  • Linguagem de manipulação de dados SQL
  • Linguagens de Programação (e.g. Python, Java, Scala) e Shell Script (Linux/Unix)
  • Boas práticas de Engenharia de software para esteiras de CI/CD, envolvendo design patterns, testes automatizados e SRE

• Vale Transporte

• Vale Refeição (Restaurantes) / Vale Alimentação (Supermercados)

• Convênio médico e odontológico

• Seguro de Vida

• PLR – Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Mediante resultados do banco)

• Descontos exclusivos em nossos produtos financeiros

Você conhece a Bunge?

Distribuída em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 117 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos. Valorizamos a diversidade de nossos times e buscamos talentos criativos com espírito de equipe e vontade de fazer a diferença. Em tudo o que fazemos, colocamos em prática nossos valores:

  • Atuar como um só time, promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;

  • Buscar a excelência, sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;

  • Fazer o que é certo, agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Na Bunge, valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e trabalhamos em prol de uma cultura inclusiva e de pertencimento, com respeito e equidade. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas como são!

Nossa empresa possui uma sólida trajetória e estamos construindo um futuro repleto de oportunidades! Faça parte de nosso time e venha trilhar sua jornada profissional com a gente.

Um Dia na Vida:

A Auditoria Interna Global é uma função 100% rotativa e considerada uma fonte essencial de talentos para o negócio. O combustível para este motor 100% rotativo é o nosso Programa de Desenvolvimento da Auditoria Interna Global, que oferece a oportunidade de rotatividade para dentro e fora da área de negócios.

Fazer parte da equipe de Auditoria Interna Global permitirá que você:

  • Gere um retorno tangível para o negócio, participando efetivamente de uma variedade de projetos baseados em riscos e solicitados pela gestão.

  • Transforme a função, fortalecendo sua marca, por meio de sua participação em iniciativas do departamento destinadas a desenvolver talentos, aprimorar nossos serviços e construir relacionamentos produtivos com as partes interessadas.

  • Invista fortemente em seu desenvolvimento, participando ativamente do Programa de Desenvolvimento da Auditoria Interna Global.

  • Participe de outras atividades estratégicas de negócios, conforme solicitado pela gestão.

O Auditor se reportará diretamente aos Diretores de Auditoria Interna Global e aos Gerentes/Gerentes Sênior de Auditoria Interna Global. Esta função exige uma combinação de habilidades de pensamento crítico e um forte entendimento de processos de negócios e princípios de gestão de riscos.

Quais serão seus desafios?

  • Executar programas abrangentes de auditoria de acordo com as normas profissionais de auditoria, utilizando análise de dados e pensamento estratégico para avaliar e definir riscos, analisar evidências de suporte, entrevistar pessoal-chave e documentar processos e procedimentos relevantes.

  • Exercer julgamento independente para identificar e analisar observações de auditoria.

  • Fornecer atualizações regulares e oportunas ao Sênior, Sênior Líder e/ou Gerente sobre o status das atividades de auditoria, incluindo o progresso em relação aos objetivos planejados, problemas identificados e potenciais obstáculos.

  • Colaborar com os membros da equipe para comunicar efetivamente os resultados do projeto de auditoria e consultoria à gerência por meio de relatórios escritos abrangentes e apresentações orais.

  • Cultivar relacionamentos de trabalho sólidos com auditados e colegas, aproveitando efetivamente as interações individuais e a participação em reuniões de grupo.

O que gostaríamos que você tivesse?

  • Bacharelado em Contabilidade, Finanças ou área correlata.

  • Inglês Avançado.

  • Experiência em tempo integral em Auditoria, Contabilidade ou Finanças ou Negócios relacionados.

  • Conhecimento do setor (por exemplo, TI, comércio, engenharia) é uma vantagem.

  • Capacidade de aprender e aplicar princípios e práticas de auditoria interna e contabilidade, e princípios e práticas de gestão preferenciais.

  • Habilidade em analisar dados e identificar tendências e anomalias.

  • Habilidade considerável no uso do pacote Microsoft Office.

  • Habilidade considerável em comunicação verbal e escrita eficaz, incluindo habilidades de escuta ativa e habilidades em apresentar conclusões e recomendações.

  • Capacidade de estabelecer e manter relacionamentos de trabalho harmoniosos com colegas de trabalho, contatos internos e externos, e trabalhar efetivamente em um ambiente de equipe profissional.

  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente global em constante crescimento, com viagens de aproximadamente 20%.

Local de trabalho: São Paulo/SP - Pinheiros

description:
Join to apply for the Analista de Desenvolvimento SAP B1 role at Pantheon Inc .

Estamos buscando um Analista de Desenvolvimento SAP B1 para atuar na implementação e evolução do ERP SAP Business One (SAP B1) no Market4u. Esse profissional será responsável por desenvolver, personalizar e integrar o SAP B1 com os sistemas da empresa, garantindo que a solução esteja alinhada às necessidades do negócio.

O Analista de Desenvolvimento SAP B1 deverá possuir experiência com SAP B1 SDK e Service Layer, utilizando C# ou outra linguagem compatível para integrações via JSON. Além disso, será responsável por analisar requisitos, propor soluções técnicas e assegurar a qualidade e eficiência das entregas.

Nosso ambiente é dinâmico e desafiador, e buscamos alguém com forte conhecimento técnico, capacidade analítica e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as áreas internas e consultorias especializadas em SAP B1.

Como será seu dia a dia?

Seus Desafios Incluem

  1. Análise e Desenvolvimento: compreender as necessidades dos usuários e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas eficientes dentro do SAP B1.
  2. Customização e Configuração: ajustar e personalizar os módulos do SAP B1 de acordo com as exigências do Market4u.
  3. Integrações: desenvolver e manter integrações robustas entre o SAP B1 e outros sistemas utilizados pela empresa, garantindo a comunicação fluida entre as plataformas.
  4. Service Layer & APIs: implementar soluções utilizando SAP B1 SDK, C# e integrações via JSON com o Service Layer, garantindo aderência às melhores práticas.
  5. Testes e Qualidade: realizar testes para validar as implementações, garantindo estabilidade e desempenho.
  6. Suporte Técnico: oferecer suporte para usuários internos, auxiliando na resolução de problemas e otimização do uso do sistema.
  7. Treinamento: capacitar usuários-chave sobre funcionalidades do SAP B1, promovendo uma adoção eficiente da ferramenta.

Seu perfil

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Sólida experiência técnica em SAP B1 SDK e desenvolvimento de integrações e add-ons.
  • Forte conhecimento em C# ou outra linguagem aplicável para desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST via JSON.
  • Capacidade analítica para compreender as necessidades do negócio e transformá-las em soluções eficazes.
  • Habilidade de organização e documentação, garantindo rastreabilidade e qualidade no desenvolvimento.
  • Boa comunicação, facilitando o alinhamento com stakeholders e equipes internas.

O que é essencial você trazer?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e customização de SAP B1.
  • Domínio do Service Layer e APIs do SAP B1.
  • Experiência com C#, SQL e Web Services (REST, SOAP).
  • Conhecimento sobre módulos do SAP B1 e suas aplicações.
  • Capacidade de troubleshooting e resolução de problemas técnicos.
  • Experiência em testes e validações de implementações no SAP B1.

Será um diferencial se você também trouxer…

  • Conhecimento em SAP HANA e otimização de consultas SQL.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação e versionamento de código (Git, Jenkins).
  • Certificações SAP B1 ou especializações em desenvolvimento para ERP.
  • Vivência no setor de varejo ou mercados autônomos.

Se você está em busca de desafios que combinam desenvolvimento, integrações e inovação em ERP, venha fazer parte do nosso time.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

What You'll Do

As a Systems Integration Engineer, you’ll work alongside our senior engineers to plan, build, and maintain integrations between Tractian’s CMMS platform (TracOS) and enterprise systems (SAP, IBM Maximo, TOTVS, etc.). You’ll learn to translate high-level architecture into working code, assist with troubleshooting, write tests, and help ensure smooth data flows for our customers and partners.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with senior integration engineers to implement end-to-end integration solutions - helping with design, configuration, and development
  • Assist in writing and testing API clients, data transformers, and event-driven workflows (Kafka, webhooks, etc.)
  • Monitor running integrations, triage failures, and produce clear incident reports
  • Contribute to internal tools, libraries, and best-practice documentation for our integration stack
  • Communicate technical details clearly to non-technical stakeholders and help troubleshoot basic issues

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing

A Up.p busca um comercial com sólida experiência no mercado financeiro, focado em relacionamento B2B. Esse profissional será responsável por prospectar novos parceiros e qualificar leads, além de gerenciar a carteira ativa atual, mantendo um atendimento de excelência e promovendo relações comerciais estratégicas. O profissional terá um papel essencial na identificação de novas oportunidades de negócios, fortalecendo a posição da Up.p no mercado e contribuindo na divulgação dos produtos e serviços da companhia de forma estratégica e alinhada aos seus objetivos de crescimento sustentável.

Habilidades de negociação, conhecimento profundo do mercado de crédito e experiência em planejamento comercial no segmento B2B são indispensáveis para o sucesso nessa função.

  1. Prospecção de Novos Clientes e Parceiros B2B: Identificar e fechar novos parceiros no mercado que tenham aderência aos produtos de garantia da instituição, promovendo o crescimento da base de clientes e fortalecendo a rede de parceiros da Up.p.

  5. Negociação e Fechamento de Contratos: Atuar em negociações de contratos com parceiros, garantindo que os termos estejam alinhados às metas de rentabilidade e aos padrões de qualidade da Up.p.
  6. Integração com Equipes Internas: Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as demais áreas da instituição para garantir a execução das atividades comerciais.
  7. Monitoramento de Tendências de Mercado: Acompanhar as tendências do setor de crédito e identificar novas práticas e produtos que possam agregar valor à empresa e aprimorar a experiência dos parceiros e clientes.

title: Lead Technical Producer
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Lead Producer to join us on the Fortnite Core Tech team. In this position you will partner with the broader Fortnite org to help drive stability, performance, and engine development. Our team of producers focuses on platform, rendering, performance, server, game architectures, and our build pipeline. We’re looking for individuals who excel in multitasking, thrive in chaos, great communication skills, and are comfortable managing roadmaps and schedules of R&D initiatives. Ideal candidates have experience in game development or hardware frameworks, and have directly worked with engineers and the systems they develop.

In this role, you will

  • Partners with the FNTech Engineering Director to define strategies and initiatives for the vertical. Develops a roadmap feedback loop for the vertical which can speak to health, risk progress, and roll that up to the broader org.
  • Helps scale the team org and operations to support the broader Metaverse vision
  • Directly manages the Tech-Platform and Tech-Perf Prod Lead, their production org, and their initiatives. Responsible for individual growth plans and progress, that we hit quality bars for each release, and that their initiatives achieve the desired outcomes.
  • Will own some complex initiatives that needs senior direction - for example Lighthouse, UEFN
  • Operates 50% at a high level and 50% in the details managing technical initiatives

What we're looking for

  • Deep experience working with engineers and on technical projects
  • Able to drive high level goals/vision and also dig into technical details. Need to manage outcomes for the vertical but also directly own some initiatives
  • Understands how complex systems work, what they do, and why. Wants to know how everything works.
  • Strong skills in organizing unstructured work and managing multiple competing needs
  • Experience with game engines, platforms, rendering, tools, backend systems is highly desired
  • Deep experience managing large team roadmaps, rallying individual teams around common goals
  • Experience in managing/growing team orgs to scale for demand
  • Experienced working with strong personalities and still achieve the desired results

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers' objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR
  • Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers
All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.
Location: This role will be based remotely.
What your day will look like
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.
  • Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
What we are looking for in you
The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Programador de Inteligência Artificial (IA)
description:
Programador em Inteligência Artificial (IA)

Sobre a Empresa

Somos uma empresa inovadora no setor de saúde, com foco em soluções tecnológicas que transformam a experiência do cuidado domiciliar. Buscamos um Programador em Inteligência Artificial para integrar nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes que impactam positivamente a vida de pacientes, profissionais e parceiros.

Descrição do Cargo

O Programador em IA será responsável por criar, implementar e otimizar algoritmos e modelos de inteligência artificial, atuando desde o tratamento de grandes volumes de dados até a implantação de soluções em aplicações reais, como reconhecimento de voz, visão computacional e processamento de linguagem natural. Este profissional terá papel fundamental na inovação dos nossos serviços, garantindo eficiência, precisão e escalabilidade nas soluções desenvolvidas.

Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Algoritmos

Criar e implementar algoritmos de IA que permitam às máquinas aprender com dados e tomar decisões autônomas.
Adaptar e customizar algoritmos para diferentes aplicações e necessidades do negócio.


Modelagem e Tratamento de Dados

Coletar, tratar e preparar grandes volumes de dados para uso em modelos de IA.
Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados utilizados.


Implantação de Soluções de IA

Desenvolver e implantar sistemas de IA em aplicações como reconhecimento de voz, visão computacional, processamento de linguagem natural, entre outros.
Integrar soluções de IA aos sistemas existentes da empresa.


Aprendizado de Máquina

Aplicar técnicas de machine learning para criar modelos preditivos, de classificação e agrupamento.
Utilizar redes neurais e outras abordagens avançadas conforme a necessidade do projeto.


Testes e Otimização

Realizar testes rigorosos para validar o desempenho dos sistemas de IA.
Otimizar modelos e algoritmos para garantir eficiência, precisão e escalabilidade.


Documentação e Melhoria Contínua

Documentar processos, códigos e resultados dos projetos de IA.
Buscar constantemente novas técnicas, ferramentas e tendências para aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas.

Principais Habilidades

Conhecimento em Programação: Domínio de linguagens como Python (essencial), R, Java, C++ ou C#.
Matemática e Estatística: Forte base em álgebra linear, cálculo e estatística para compreensão e implementação de algoritmos.
Aprendizado de Máquina: Familiaridade com conceitos de regressão, classificação, agrupamento, redes neurais e deep learning.
Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade de identificar e solucionar desafios complexos relacionados ao desenvolvimento e implementação de IA.
Conhecimento em Sistemas Operacionais: Experiência com Linux, Windows e macOS.
Trabalho em Equipe: Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo profissionais de tecnologia, saúde e negócios.
Comunicação: Clareza na comunicação de ideias técnicas para públicos diversos.

Aplicações Práticas do Cargo

Desenvolvimento de Chatbots e Assistentes Virtuais: Sistemas de interação natural com usuários, utilizando processamento de linguagem natural.
Visão Computacional: Soluções que permitem interpretação de imagens e vídeos por máquinas.
Reconhecimento de Voz: Sistemas capazes de entender e processar a fala humana.
Recomendações Personalizadas: Algoritmos que sugerem produtos, serviços ou conteúdos com base em preferências dos usuários.
Automação de Processos: Otimização de fluxos operacionais por meio de IA.

Requisitos

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência comprovada em projetos de IA e machine learning.
Conhecimento em frameworks e bibliotecas de IA (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Keras, etc.).
Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais.
Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e artigos científicos.

Diferenciais

Pós-graduação ou cursos de especialização em IA, Data Science ou áreas afins.
Experiência no segmento de saúde.
Participação em comunidades, eventos ou publicações na área de IA.

You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.

You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as a Consultant, you will continue to learn and deepen your consulting skills by working on various projects. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.

Primary Responsibilities

The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.

You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
  • Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
  • Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
  • Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
  • Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
  • Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
  • Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
  • Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
  • Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.

The Ideal Candidate:

Passionate and Engaged: Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.

Self-Driven and Inquisitive: Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.

Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player: Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.

Minimum Role Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
  • An undergraduate degree is required.
  • Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
  • Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
  • Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
  • Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?

Oferecemos um ambiente em que todos são protagonistas e agentes de transformação. Temos um excelente clima organizacional com pessoas engajadas em entregar os melhores resultados, assim como grandes oportunidades de crescimento para você.

Responsibilities and assignments

  • Identificar, avaliar e documentar os riscos presentes no ambiente de trabalho.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares para identificar condições inseguras, atos inseguros e outros perigos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar programas e políticas de segurança no trabalho.
  • Propor e auxiliar na implantação de medidas de prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais.
  • Ministrar treinamentos de segurança para os funcionários, abordando questões como o uso adequado de EPIs (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual), procedimentos de evacuação, manipulação segura de substâncias perigosas, entre outros.
  • Promover a conscientização sobre a segurança no local de trabalho.
  • Investigar acidentes de trabalho para determinar as causas e desenvolver planos de ação para evitar sua recorrência.
  • Manter registros de acidentes e incidentes e fornecer relatórios às autoridades competentes.
  • Monitorar o uso correto de EPIs e garantir que estejam disponíveis e em boas condições.
  • Realizar a seleção, aquisição e distribuição adequada de EPIs.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares do ambiente de trabalho para verificar a conformidade com as normas de segurança.
  • Coordenar auditorias de segurança e acompanhar a implementação de recomendações.
  • Preparar relatórios e documentação relacionados à segurança no trabalho.
  • Manter registros atualizados, incluindo planos de emergência, análises de riscos, relatórios de treinamento, entre outros.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas regulamentadoras de segurança no trabalho, de acordo com a legislação vigente.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as regulamentações e garantir que a empresa esteja em conformidade.
  • Colaborar com comitês de segurança ou grupos de trabalho internos para desenvolver estratégias de segurança e promover a conscientização entre os funcionários.
  • Fornecer treinamento em primeiros socorros e garantir que os kits de primeiros socorros estejam disponíveis e bem equipados.
  • Comunicar regularmente com a gerência e funcionários sobre questões de segurança.
  • Advogar pela importância da segurança no ambiente de trabalho e apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Realizar avaliações ergonômicas para identificar condições de trabalho que possam causar estresse ou lesões musculoesqueléticas.

  • Diploma de Curso Técnico;

  • Estar apto a implementar programas de prevenção de acidentes e doenças ocupacionais;
  • Habilidades em treinamento e educação em segurança no trabalho são fundamentais para capacitar os funcionários a seguir as práticas de segurança;
  • Conhecimento de Primeiros Socorros;
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas: ser capaz de identificar riscos e desenvolver soluções para melhorar a segurança no trabalho.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, for daily collaboration with distributed teams
  • 6 + years of professional frontend development experience, with 3 + years building production React applications
  • Expert knowledge of TypeScript , React hooks, context, and modern state management approaches

Nice-to-Have
  • Hands-on experience with Next.js 14 / 15 (App Router, server components, edge functions)
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-library tooling such as Storybook or Radix UI
  • Exposure to data-visualization libraries (Recharts, Victory, D3)
  • Experience deploying static or server-rendered front ends on AWS S3 + CloudFront, Vercel, or Netlify
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for frontend assets (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
  • Interest in AI and LLM-driven UX patterns, prompt design, and workflow automations

The Marketing Innovations Team at Agoda identifies & develops new marketing channels that have high growth potential. We seek a resourceful candidate who can effectively navigate the organization to gather necessary information and implement innovative solutions while adapting to evolving scenarios and leveraging valuable resources creatively.
  • Strong Communication Skills:Exceptional writing and verbal communication abilities, with proficiency in creating impactful and visually appealing presentations.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to effectively communicate, influence and persuade with different levels of stakeholders (including Senior Management) with proven strong commercial acumen

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience in digital or social media marketing
  • Experience in hypothesis testing frameworks, statistical analysis, and using Python/R for data manipulation and analysis.

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Proficiência avançada em Linux (RedHat, SUSE, Debian) e Windows Server , com capacidade de gerenciar e solucionar problemas em ambientes complexos.
  • Virtualização: Domínio avançado de VMware (vSphere, vCenter, ESXi) e Microsoft Hyper-V , incluindo clustering, migração de máquinas virtuais e otimização de performance.
  • Cloud Computing: Experiência comprovada em ambientes multicloud com AWS , Azure , Google Cloud , IBM Cloud e Huawei Cloud , incluindo a migração e gerenciamento de workloads em cloud.
  • Redes e Virtualização de Rede: Conhecimento sólido de redes (TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN) e experiência com virtual switches , roteamento e isolamento de rede em ambientes virtualizados.
  • Automação de Infraestrutura: Habilidade prática em Ansible e Terraform para automação de provisionamento, configuração e gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC).

Administers all forms of respiratory care, both critical and general therapy, and directs and manages the respiratory and pulmonary care for a designated group of patients. Provides respiratory assessment, support, treatment, and diagnostic tests as part of the healthcare team.

Job Duties

  • Conducts evaluation, management and care of patients with deficiencies and abnormalities of the cardiopulmonary system.

  • Associate’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care.

  • RRT - Registered Respiratory Therapist NBRC - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year.
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days.
  • PALS - Pediatric Advanced Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • NRP - Neonatal Resuscitation Program - State of Pennsylvania within 60 Days.
  • RCP - Respiratory Care Practitioner - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree Graduate from an RRT program accredited by the commission of accreditation for Respiratory Care.

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Accounting & Tax Manager - Telecommunications
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.


With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.


Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (“MVNO”) in nine countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 400 experts across 13 countries.

Position Overview

The Tax & Accounting Manager role sits within the Financial Control team, reporting directly to the Head of Treasury, Risk and Compliance, and is based out of our São Paulo, Brazil office. The primary focus will be on Brazilian financial management, including accounting, tax compliance, and regulatory financial reporting for our MVNO operations in Brazil. The role will oversee financial operations for our registrations in both São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro. As 1GLOBAL expands its MVNO operations in the Brazilian market, this role offers exposure to a wide range of financial areas—accounting, tax compliance, regulatory reporting, and financial planning—within the complex Brazilian telecommunications regulatory environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional with telecommunications experience looking to develop in a fast-growing, multinational environment with diverse and evolving financial and regulatory challenges.


The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.


Key Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Manage all accounting operations for 1GLOBAL's Brazilian entities, ensuring compliance with Brazilian accounting standards (including CPC/IFRS) and practices.
  • Prepare financial statements for Brazilian operations in accordance with local requirements.
  • Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment with group reporting and audit requirements.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for external auditors for Brazilian operations, including statutory audits.


Tax Compliance & Filing

  • Manage tax registrations and compliance for both São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro operations, including state registrations (Inscrição Estadual) in both states.
  • Prepare and file all federal tax returns (including IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS), state tax returns (ICMS), and municipal tax returns (ISS) in Brazil.

LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital - Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital- Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital - Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary

Performs CT scans of designated anatomy using professional judgment while imaging with regard to technical quality according to physician specifications. Provides courteous and professional delivery of CT technical exams and procedures while adhering to radiation safety precautions. Supports patient questions and concerns regarding exam procedures and process, while maintaining appropriate confidentiality regarding PHI and HIPPA related information. On-call as required by the department. Works in a hospital facility that offers full hospital services. Provides direct patient care to high acuity patients encompassing emergency, inpatient and outpatient classes supporting up to and including trauma and ICU.

Job Duties

  • Performs all types of imaging procedures and operates all equipment safely and properly including scanners, injectors, and monitors.
  • Reviews all images of all exams, repeating images as necessary for best possible result.
  • Communicates with the patient by addressing the patient by name, introducing self to the patient, explaining the exam in lay terms and keeping the patient informed of exam progress.
  • Prepares patient images to PACs for interpretation by a radiologist and administers contrast media per protocol.
  • Completes technical notes, verifies images, and sends exams to PACS promptly.
  • Notifies physician of any adverse reaction to contrast media or change in patient's condition.
  • Reviews patient chart/script prior to initiating exam to verify pertinent information.
  • Prepares patients for CT procedures by accurately assessing patient’s needs, medical history, and provides patient education.
  • Operates computed tomography scanner for data acquisition, reconstruction of images, documentation of images, and performs quality control measures for the purpose of ensuring optimal quality images.
  • Attends department meetings or other mandatory meetings with a positive attitude.
  • Practices accurate and timely completion of scheduled and unscheduled work to maximize productivity.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Technical School Diploma Graduate of accredited Radiography program or equivalent or
  • CNMT, RT(CT) Certified
  • Less than 1 year experience as a Radiologic Technologist
  • Ability to provide proper patient care essential to radiologic procedures.
  • Knowledge and skills to perform scans on patients of all ages, adapting to various protocols.
  • Proficient use of the advanced software for CT scanning and post procedure processing applications.
  • Strong aptitude for CT technology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, positive attitude, and upbeat demeanor.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support - State of Pennsylvania within 30 Days
  • RT - Registered Technologist Radiology - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire or
  • CNMT - Certified Nuclear Med Tech NMTCB - State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire
  • CT - Computed Tomography ARRT - State of Pennsylvania within 1 Year

Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate’s Degree Graduate of Health Science program
  • Knowledge and skills to perform venipuncture.

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 40-50 lbs. Examples: Push/pull patients on bed, stretcher (requires 29 lbs. push force), lateral transfers up to 50 lbs. of the patient's weight. Frequent to continuous standing/walking. Patient transporters can walk 8-10 miles per shift. *Patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Company Description

At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Job Description

The position is to be based full time at site in Campinas surroundings.

The Senior Construction Project Manager will carry out activities on site to support DCD Area in controlling of the project execution that includes:

  • Set up chair and minute all client meetings, ensuring that DCD, DCE and DCOPs are fully informed.
  • Reporting on a weekly basis to the DCD PM of scope, budget and schedule status, and any other issues arising related to the construction contracts
  • Liaise with the Client, Professional Team and Contractor to establish all key project processes and monitor these processes reporting and making recommendations to the Client.
  • Engage FAT / SAT attendance and Vendor attendance to site as appropriate
  • Liaise with the Client, Professional Team, Engineer of Record, A/E and Contractors to establish, review and regularly update the Project Risk Register. Agree and monitor Risk Mitigation Plans and provide input into quantitative risk analysis reviews.
  • Initiate any actions/escalations such as acceleration programs for tasks falling behind and impacting critical path
  • Monitor and report on Commissioning process, checking that the Commissioning Agent has developed a Commissioning Plan and all necessary test sheets and documentation
  • Liaise with the DC Operations team to coordinate their involvement in all installation, commissioning, and snagging activities.
  • Coordinate all parties to complete Practical Completion documentation and that all manuals are submitted and approved to an agreed schedule
  • Establish and manage the defect identification and resolution process, and monitor all handover activity to Client's Turn-Over process
  • Liaise with Integration Lead to develop and manage the Integration plan
  • Coordinate processes of issuance of RFI´s, submittals, transmittals and other documents that must be revised and approved by the A/E or the EoR on time, so the schedule does not get impacted

The Senior Construction Project Manager is also expected to support the DCD Project Manager with the following:

  • Drive LLE, M&E and other technical design issues through to completion
  • Monitor and report on OFCI LLE and other construction coordination on site.
  • Prepare reports for Client's stakeholders on LLE and M&E vendor issues
  • Prepare and issue for the DCD PM’s approval a monthly Project Manager’s report, weekly status update reports and provide input into other stakeholder reports and presentations as may be required
  • Provide supporting information for the DCD PM’s input into Payment Application Reports and assist the Cost Manager to present these for approval to Client's management
  • Support the change management process by liaising with the Client, Professional Team, and Contractor in clarifying all necessary scopes, justification, and technical detail.
  • Liaise with the Professional Team around time/scope impacts assessments, and validity for change or variation events
  • Report on General Contractor and vendor adherence to the Commissioning tagging process
  • Coordinate MOP elaboration and revision with the GC and Safety areas.
  • Assist to identify early warning of construction, Mechanical and Electrical risks, and issues.
  • Monitor site works and record and report non-conforming work and drive the team for follow up, preventative, and close out actions.
  • Manage the General Contractor to undertake regular site Mechanical and Electrical quality audits and witness site tests as may be necessary
  • Chair and manage risk workshops
  • Establish and manage risk and change management processes and promote project team compliance to project process
  • Monitor and use reasonable endeavors to manage the General Contractor in line with company health and safety standards. Revise MOPs.
  • Manage the General Contractor to prepare all necessary schedules for the handover of the project and liaise with Integration Manager, Commissioning Manager and DC Operations Manager on agreement with the schedules.
  • Manage the General Contractor in timely preparation of system start up books and Operations and Maintenance Manuals
  • Manage the General Contractor in the preparation and room handover documentation with input as necessary from the Architect Engineer
  • Promote a team approach to punch-list development using the tools made available for the project
  • Liaise with DC Operations / Security Operations and check that systems and permits are in place to enable General Contractor to access the site and complete any necessary remedial works post lock-down and turn-over
  • Inform and monitor the General Contractor’s compliance to DC Operations / Security Operations processes during execution of post turn-over works.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
  • Lean Construction Certification and/or PMP Certification is a plus.

Experience/Skills/Education:

  • Over 7 years' experiencein similar responsibilities.

  • Strong Verbal and Written Communication Skills in Portuguese and English are mandatory

O GRUPO EURO17 está em busca de um Analista de Modelagem de Crédito para se juntar à nossa equipe. Se você é apaixonado(a) pela área de Crédito, essa pode ser a oportunidade perfeita para você.

  1. Desenvolver, validar e monitorar modelos de credit scoring, behavior scoring e collection scoring para concessão e gestão do crédito na SCD e na Securitizadora;
  2. Criar e aprimorar regras e políticas de crédito, alinhadas com a estratégia da empresa e regulamentação do setor;

  1. Formação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Experiência comprovada com modelagem estatística e machine learning aplicados ao risco de crédito;
  3. Domínio de Python, R, SQL e ferramentas de modelagem estatística (ex.: Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, SAS);
  4. Experiência na construção de motores de decisão e automação de fluxos de crédito;
  5. Conhecimento de arquitetura de dados para modelagem de crédito em bancos ou fintechs;

Diferenciais

  • Experiência no setor financeiro, especialmente em SCDs, fintechs, bancos digitais ou securitizadoras;
  • Experiência com implementação de modelos em ambiente de produção;
  • Conhecimentos em cloud computing (AWS, GCP, Azure) e pipelines de dados;
  • Familiaridade com regulações do Banco Central para concessão de crédito digital;
  • Domínio de frameworks regulatórios como IFRS 9, Basileia e LGPD.

Salário competitivo, oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e pacote de benefícios abrangente. Se você é um candidato motivado e orientado para os resultados, com experiência em conformidade financeira, envie seu currículo com uma carta de apresentação para candidatar-se a esta posição.
